subject: STABLE step 4: render_encoder.inc afa61a3d (set*Bytes sub-allocation)
body: setVertexBytes/setFragmentBytes now copy into the per-encoder expandArena (256-aligned) instead of newBufferWithBytes (one GPU BO alloc+map per call, >=16 KiB each). Planner view kept IDENTICAL: tegu_render_bytes_view() presents a bytes slot to the generic planner as its own {length=len, offset relative} buffer, and the GENERIC_BUFFER descriptor memory becomes base+descriptor_offset (bounds checked against both len and arena). set*BufferOffset on a bytes slot stays relative to the bytes (as with its own buffer). Expanded index-draw vertex buffers (same arena object) are excluded from the bytes view. Non-generic paths see the real arena binding (offset X). Evidence: bench C6F_BYTES=1 (7 set*Bytes per draw, 200 draws, distinct data each) - 3810 bound descriptor ranges read back byte-exact from the arena, plan memo hits 1256/1274 (view stable), GPU BOs ~11 arena chunks per 200 draws instead of 1400; encode 1.3 ms/200 draws host (fake kernel makes alloc cheap; device saves 7 kernel alloc+map+unmap/free per draw). Gates: CA ASan+release PASS, run_host_tests 54 PASS to known stop, render harness rc0 (32 as baseline), integration checks=1005 required_failures=2 (CoreAnimation pass 66/42 as c6l). Next: native indexed draws for attribute shaders once your n2r admits them (I see PASS native indexed attribute draws in run_host_tests) - please post the n2r contract (vertex range expectation, index alignment) and I will switch drawIndexedPrimitives.
